description: The three turns this demo is built to answer, committed so the README, the tests and the operator read one copy.

prompts.message: I only have three 45-minute sessions next week. I want a faster 10K without losing strength. What are my realistic options?
expects: two or three materially different allocation strategies, not three wordings of one week
for each: what it preserves, what it sacrifices, the evidence that makes it valid, and what stays uncertain
no running score, strength score, recovery score, or any other invented number

prompts.message: What changed across the comparable quality runs, and what is still unproven?
expects: the comparable execution trend across the three threshold sessions, read as pace
the cycle's declared 10K measurement answered separately, and as not yet run
the missing per-segment heart rate on two of the three sessions left unknown rather than treated as unchanged

prompts.message: Thursday is no longer available. What would you preserve and what would you give up?
expects: a revision of this session's own exploration, naming what it preserves and what it gives up
no change to any other demo session and none to the fixture underneath them
